sanskrit_verse:
सामान्यं पुत्रदारादि सर्वस्वं न्यासयाचितम् ।
प्रतिश्रुतं तथान्यस्य न देयं त्वष्टधा स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: sāmānyaṃ putradārādi sarvasvaṃ nyāsayācitam | pratīśrutaṃ tathānyasya na deyaṃ tvaṣṭadhā smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Property, wife, child, or any possession acquired through legal commitment or pledged to another shall not be transferred or claimed by any other party under eight defined conditions of non-transferability.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from rightful acquisition and lawful commitment
Causation is determined by integrity of contractual alignment
Capacity-based responsibility arises from conscious pledging
Restoration logic demands return to original integrity structure
Consciousness alignment requires honoring of committed relational structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF property/relationship is acquired via legal commitment THEN no external claimant has enforceable right
IF asset is pledged to Party A THEN transfer to Party B is invalid across all eight non-transferable categories
IF conscious pledge exists THEN reallocation must honor sequential cause-effect chain
IF breach occurs THEN restoration protocol activates prior-to-breach state
IF misalignment detected THEN initiate reintegration with source-conscious holder
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, claims involving familial or proprietary rights grounded in conscious commitments must prioritize ontological continuity over procedural technicalities. The threshold of responsibility lies in the original act of intentional pledging, which supersedes third-party assertions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that what is given or pledged originates from a specific agent's willful alignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that disruption to such alignment necessitates return to source integrity without punitive overlay. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity at time of commitment. Non-punitive reality rule affirms correction restores dharma, not inflicts suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reconnect parties to original intention matrix
Activate Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Engage current holder in conscious reaffirmation
Deploy Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign energetic ownership field
Execute Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Nullify conflicting claims through consciousness-based verification
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. This law executes Dharma through restoration, upholds consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator, and affirms reality operates beyond punitive frameworks.
